name: 11231 · Brooklyn, NY
findings: ZIP 11231 (Brooklyn) has 151 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11231 (Brooklyn) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
